stories.title: Policing remains a touchy subject in Northern Ireland
stories.summary: As the Police Service of Northern Ireland marks its 25th anniversary, the BBC's Mark Simpson tries to get the views of the public it serves.

stories.title: Cross snatch late win over Gowna to progress in Ulster
stories.summary: Rian O'Neill's last-gasp score secures a 1-22 to 2-18 comeback win for Crossmaglen in their Ulster Club SFC quarter-final against Gowna at Breffni Park.

stories.title: Fine Gael proposes unity forum to consider Ireland's constitutional future
stories.summary: The plans come as part of Fine Gael's "blueprint" on Irish unity, which was published at their ard fheis.

stories.title: St Eunan's beat Erne Gaels to reach Ulster last four
stories.summary: St Eunan's Letterkenny book their place in the Ulster Club SFC semi-finals with a 1-14 to 0-10 win over Erne Gaels Belleek at Brewster Park.

stories.title: Rahm edges ahead of Hatton & McIlroy in Abu Dhabi
stories.summary: Jon Rahm leads Tyrrell Hatton and Francesca Laporta by one shot, and Rory McIlroy by two, after the third round of the Abu Dhabi Championship.

stories.title: Man, 35, in court charged with murder of Carrie Mullane
stories.summary: Michael Lynch, of Trasna Park in Enniskillen appeared via video link before Dungannon Magistrates' Court on Saturday morning.

stories.title: Ireland going from strength to strength - Murray
stories.summary: Former Ireland scrum-half Conor Murray says on the Ireland Rugby Social that he is impressed with how the Irish squad is progressing and their strength in depth.

stories.title: 'People have been knitting and crocheting for the past year' - cascading poppies for Remembrance
stories.summary: Towns and villages have been marking the sacrifice of those who died in war ahead of Remembrance Sunday.

stories.title: The woman capturing the beauty of the skies on camera
stories.summary: Rachel Cassidy's picture - A Midsummer Night’s Dream - captures a display of noctilucent clouds.

stories.title: 'You feel that you're not alone' - the young people finding community in grief
stories.summary: Too Young to Grieve is an informal peer support community providing young people with a space to grieve.

stories.title: Keenan hat-trick as six-try Ireland beat Pumas
stories.summary: Hugo Keenan scores a hat-trick of tries as Ireland open the home leg of the Nations Championship with a commanding bonus-point win over Argentina in Dublin.

stories.title: Child, 6, dies weeks after Waterford arson attack
stories.summary: The attack happened last month at the family home on the outskirts of Waterford in the Republic of Ireland.
